reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, valid_from,
  LEAD(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) - valid_from AS days_to_next
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from,
  (SELECT MIN(p2.valid_from) FROM price_history p2 WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id AND p2.valid_from > p.valid_from) - p.valid_from AS days_to_next
FROM price_history p
WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25

SELECT product_id, valid_from,
  LAG(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from DESC) - valid_from AS days_to_next
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from,
  (SELECT MIN(p2.valid_from) FROM price_history p2 WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id AND p2.valid_from > p.valid_from) - p.valid_from AS days_to_next
FROM price_history p
WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
other_way.tradeoff: The earliest later valid_from from a subquery gives the same next date, but rereads the table for each version.
